title: Jev gets a native decisions endpoint
summary:
Jev gained a native decisions API, Mistral Small 4 got a direct route, and a community image studio joined the catalog.

Added `POST /alpha/decisions` for JSON requests with a state and named choice, score, or noul questions. It returns answers and token usage, and Ask Jev MCP now uses the same request schema. The team also made `typesafe/jev-1.13` the canonical model name in API responses while keeping `jev` and `typesafe/jev` as aliases.

Mistral Small 4 and its existing aliases now route through Mistral’s direct API rather than OpenRouter, with the same checkpoint and a 64,000-token output default. The fallback remains available.

Community-built Atelier joined the image app catalog. Its English and Simplified Chinese interface supports prompt-based generation and reference-image editing with the Pollinations image API.

daily.title: Typed decisions with Jev
daily.text: Send a state and named choice, score, or noul questions as JSON to `POST /alpha/decisions`. Get native answers and token usage back without packing the request into a chat message. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
